passage:
At sixteen, Usha spent one week telling everyone that her friend Ojas was the kindest person in class. Ojas saved her a seat, shared notes and remembered her tea order. Then Ojas laughed at the wrong moment when a teacher read out her low quiz mark. By Friday Usha was calling Ojas a total traitor and deleting old photos. Nothing in her mind allowed a friend to be caring and careless in the same week.
At twenty-two, Usha started her first job and moved in with two flatmates. In the first month Bhupen forgot to pay his share of the internet, and the old heat rose in her chest. She could have written him off. Instead she remembered how the Ojas story ended: months of silence over one bad afternoon. She opened the flat's chat. "Let's split groceries and internet three ways, and buy rice, dal and oil in bulk from the wholesale market on Sundays." Bhupen sent a thumbs-up and paid that night. Their salaries stretched further, and the flat stayed friendly.

qa.q: What did Usha propose the flatmates buy in bulk from the wholesale market?
qa.a: She proposed buying rice, dal and oil in bulk on Sundays.

qa.q: How does Usha's reaction to Ojas at sixteen differ from her handling of Bhupen at twenty-two?
qa.a: At sixteen, one slight turned Ojas from perfect to a total traitor, all good then all bad. At twenty-two she felt the same heat toward Bhupen but held his lapse alongside the rest, and settled it with a shared-cost plan that helped everyone.

qa.q: What was Usha feeling when Bhupen forgot the internet payment?
qa.a: She felt angry and let down, a strong old heat in her chest, and she was tempted to write him off as she once did with Ojas.

qa.q: What could Usha do next if a flatmate keeps missing payments even with the plan?
qa.a: She could bring it up calmly in the flat chat or in person, say what she needs, and agree on a clear way to pay so the arrangement stays fair.

grounding: An all-good-then-all-bad view of a friend (3896) contrasted with a later calm, cost-sharing approach to a flatmate's lapse (6861) in one person's life.
